hypothesis: Compare native fast/slow TD, fully fitted conventional binned tabular TD, and fully fitted conventional recurrent-linear TD on both identical public training data and independently run equal-budget paired evaluation episodes. Shared-data fitting does not prove action quality or causal exploration.
learning_phase: identical ordered, legally obtained public FIT transition tuples across all arms; FIT-only tuning; require each arm consume equal counts; model freeze before scored episodes
evaluation_phase: independent source-owner process per arm and trial, matched public evaluation seed/cohort IDs frozen before first use, policies choose binary action from four real-valued observables, no online parameter fitting during scored episodes, episode return/length/termination and resource metrics scored without privileged info
cohort_separation: real FIT, VALID and one DEV identities must be admitted/frozen and disjoint by existing FORGE FSA; this engineering branch consumes zero originals and no actual protected seed list
comparison_protocol: evaluate individual paired trial returns per arm on identically identified cohorts; no inter-arm state sharing or reward replay from a competitor during evaluation; report per-arm returns, episode lengths, action calls, wall/CPU, max child RSS, serialized model bytes, and baseline-adjusted signed differences without selection on DEV
bias_checks: no hidden source wind/private info/graph/counterfactual return
cold-process model restoration and per-arm episode state reset
fixed number of evaluation episodes/trials, source-owner records original terminal or truncation
paired ID equality, no duplicate trials or overlap with FIT/VALID
admission and protected claims require independent FSA receipts external to this code; a structural digest or locally written JSON never suffices

forbidden: automatic model selection, acceptance or production promotion

scoring_note: Pure static parser/score-aggregation on hardcoded synthetic PUBLIC metrics for development. Every output must self-label source-only and scientific_go=false; no claims of actual environment performance.
follow_on: Only original existing FSA owner can admit freeze/source/seeds/steps/budgets and produce original independent start/witness; prepare training/evaluation adapter only after that admission contract is qualified. No DEV peeking or post-DEV adaptation.
